West Bengal Name Change 2026 | Paschim Banga | West Bengal Latest News | Paschim Banga Bill | Article 3
West Bengal Name Change is once again in the news as the proposal to rename the state as Paschim Banga gains momentum. West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya has said that the state government will introduce a Bill in the Assembly to rename West Bengal as Paschim Banga. The proposed name is being linked to the historical and cultural identity of the state.

But will West Bengal officially become Paschim Banga? What is the constitutional process for changing the name of an Indian state? In this video, we explain the complete West Bengal Name Change issue in simple language.

The video covers West Bengal Name Change 2026, Paschim Banga Name Change, Paschim Banga Bill, West Bengal Latest News, Article 3 of the Indian Constitution, First Schedule and the role of the State Assembly, Parliament and President.
Changing the name of a state involves a constitutional process. The current proposal is expected to begin with action at the state level, followed by the required Union-level parliamentary process. The First Schedule of the Constitution would also need to reflect the final change.
The demand to rename West Bengal is not new. Previous governments had also attempted to change the state's name, including proposals such as Paschim Banga and Bangla, but earlier attempts did not result in an official name change.

This topic is highly important for UPSC, WBCS, State PCS, Current Affairs and Indian Polity.
Watch the complete video to understand the West Bengal Name Change Latest News, Paschim Banga proposal, constitutional procedure, historical background and Article 3.
